meta.parties: Muttiah Chetty v. Dingiria Et Al

rules.statement: Marriage does not confer majority on a Kandyan minor wife under the applicable laws.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear, of course, that if Roman-Dutch Law governs the case, marriage confers emancipation: Deeresekere v. Goonesakere; 1 and also-to put aside at the outset a preliminary argument suggested by Mr. Hector Jayewardene on behalf of the appellant-that section 502 of the Civil Procedure Code throws no light on the problem we have now to solve."
